subject: infoschema_v2: remove schemaTableInfos call of DeadTableLockChecker (#55956)
summary: DeadTableLockChecker switches from per-schema `SchemaTableInfos` scanning to `ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute` filtered on `TableInfo.Lock != nil`, and uses `TableInfo.DBID` as `SchemaID`. Special-attribute filter types/constants are centralized in `pkg/infoschema/context` and wired through both infoschema v1/v2 implementations.
